messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started for v2.8.3 -> slices: us-1, eu-1, apac-1. Canary 5%. Owner @maya. Release notes https://internal.redwood/release/v2.8.3
maya: Preflight checklist: capacity cushions recommended: US 25%, EU 20%, APAC 30%. Will run smoke tests. Pin rules below.
ken: Running preflight capacity check now, posting summary in ~8m.
ops-bot: scheduled change window: US 01:00-03:00 PDT, EU 09:00-11:00 CEST, APAC 02:00-04:00 JST.
deploy-bot: Canary health checks: p50 48ms / p95 420ms, error rate 0.12% — passing so far.
maya: Rollback triggers: 5xx >0.5% sustained 10m OR error rate >0.7% over 5m OR p95 latency >900ms. If triggered, pin to v2.8.2 and route traffic to fallback variants.
anika: Added fallback policy for APAC: `route.prefer=gpu` -> `route.fallback=cpu-quantized-apac`. Will push config in 3m.
jamal: Capacity snapshot (live): US healthy nodes 75/105 (28% spare), EU 48/60 (20% spare), APAC 21/30 (30% spare). Note: eu-west-2 maint starts in ~2h, adjust cushion to 22% if needed.
sara: Oncall watching metrics. I'll hold at canary 5% for 15m then give thumbs up if stable. Alert thresholds set.
ken: Smoke test summary: prompt set A/B run -> passes. No OOMs. Sample outputs look good. `curl -X POST ...` logs ok.
maya: Plan: US -> ramp to 30% after 15m observation, then US full; if stable, EU canary -> EU full; APAC last with extra cushion. Pin windows: 5m observation between each ramp.
ops-bot: Reminder: auto-throttle will trigger on rate-limit spikes; if throttles >2% in a slice we stop rollout.
sara: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: US ramp to 30% started.
maya: If anything odd, call rollback immediately and ping #eng-sre. I'll update the release ticket when rollout completes.
deploy-bot: US reached 100% for slice us-1, EU remains pinned at canary. Final note: open follow-up for post-release perf evals.
